FM03.reasoning: The agent makes no explicit effort to handle missing values or outliers, relying entirely on LightGBM's default handling without any explicit cleaning strategy.

FM12.reasoning: The agent uses an unweighted average of the 5 cross-validation fold models to generate test predictions without attempting to tune the combination.

other_failure_modes.name: No validation metrics reported
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs cross-validation but fails to calculate, log, or report any performance metrics on the validation folds, making it impossible to evaluate the model's offline performance before submission.

other_failure_modes.name: Synthetic IDs in submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates a submission file using a synthetic ID sequence instead of extracting and preserving the original identifier column from the test dataset, which usually leads to submission misalignment.

other_failure_modes.name: Training on ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops only the target column and the parsed date column from the feature set, meaning any existing dataset identifiers (like 'id' or 'ID') will inappropriately be used as predictive features.

summary: The agent implements a standard 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with LightGBM, including basic date feature extraction and categorical encoding. However, it fails to perform any explicit data cleaning (relying entirely on the model to handle missing values), uses a naive unweighted ensemble of the fold models, and completely fails to calculate or report any validation metrics. Furthermore, it creates a submission file with synthetic IDs rather than preserving potential test set identifiers, and likely leaks identifier columns into the training features.
